There existed a [[Sentience|sentient]] '''species''' of tall bipeds characterized by a [[horse]]-like elongated snout. Notable members of that [[species]] included [[Defancio Storsilt]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and [[Askroh]].<ref name="Family Affair 1">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=10|story=Tales from Wild Space: Family Affair, Part 1}}</ref>

==Biology and appearance==
This sentient species was distinguished by their tall statures and horse-like appearances..<ref name="TLJ" />

==Species in the galaxy==
Sometime between [[10 BBY]] and [[3 ABY]],<ref name="FA1 Date">Tales from Wild Space: "Family Affair, Part 1" takes place in between ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' and [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' places ''Solo: A Star Wars Story'' nine [[Standard year|years]] after the founding of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates that event to [[19 BBY]], and also dates ''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'' to [[3 ABY]], meaning ''Solo: A Star Wars Story'' takes place in [[10 BBY]] and Tales from Wild Space: "Family Affair, Part 1" takes place between these two years.</ref> a member of this species named [[Askroh]] served as a [[crime lord]] in [[Cloud City]] on the [[planet]] [[Bespin]].<ref name="Family Affair 1">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=10|story=Tales from Wild Space: Family Affair, Part 1}}</ref> Later, in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="TLJ Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. ''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'' takes place immediately after the end of ''The Force Awakens''.</ref> another member of this species, [[Defancio Storsilt]], was present at [[Canto Casino and Racetrack]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]].<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Defancio-Storsilt-Concept.jpg|thumb|right|200px|King 2 by Jake Lunt Davies]]
This species first appeared in the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], directed by [[Rian Johnson]].<ref name="TLJ" /> They were originally designed by concept artist [[Ivan Manzella]], and were referred to by the production code "King 2."<ref name="TLJ Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref> According to the Keeper of the Holocron, [[Leland Chee]], as of [[April 1]], [[2025]], this species still did not have a name within the official [[Holocron continuity database]].<ref name="Unnamed Aliens">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1356720840036847656|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Unnamed-Species-TLJ.png}}</ref>
